methods.symbols: Flatten NATIONAL_FLAGS. Test each nonempty local path against baseline public/ Git tree; count IDs; flag only numeric from > to. An existing file does not prove authenticity.
methods.sources: Inspect declared sources arrays and URL hostnames. Wikipedia-only requires a nonempty array whose every hostname is wikipedia.org or a subdomain. This does not inspect every linked page or establish truth.
methods.anthems: Group NATIONAL_ANTHEMS by youtubeId and report duplicates with configured offsets. Shared identity/compilation exemptions require review.
methods.geometry: Parse every public/subdivisions/*.json blob. Recursively inspect coordinate ranges and ring closure. No polygon legality, topology or surveyed-border certification.
methods.codes: Compare raw subdivisionMeta division code sets with GeoJSON iso_3166_2 sets. Runtime aliases and deliberate merges are not resolved by this comparison.
methods.coverage: Union of COUNTRY_FACTS, NATIONAL_FLAGS, SUBDIVISION_META and POLITICAL_PARTIES keys. Geometry-only codes remain in geometry_files; not a sovereign-state census.
